title: Stop forecasting demand with Excel. A practical guide to AI replenishment for distribution. — Trackeys

hero.h1: Stop forecasting demand with Excel. A practical guide to AI replenishment for distribution.
hero.p: Classical forecasts assume tomorrow looks like yesterday. AI models handle promotions, seasonality and new-product launches — without hand-tuning 200 parameters.

sections.sub:
Demand forecasting in FMCG distribution is still mostly a spreadsheet exercise. That's not because the spreadsheets are wrong — it's because the people running them are genuinely good at what they do. The problem is ceiling: at a certain SKU × store × week granularity, no human can hold enough context to be accurate.
Three places: handling promo uplift as a continuous signal instead of a flag, recognizing seasonality at long tail (not just the top 20 SKUs), and cold-starting new products off taxonomy instead of history. Plus the obvious one — just doing all of it across millions of SKU-store combos.
